topic: TCP stream framing and HTTP message boundaries
status: mental-model-built; serve loop not yet fully implemented

model.reader: StreamReader object supplied through asyncio.start_server callback chain; await reader.read(n) yields bytes
model.buffer: required because TCP read chunks are not HTTP message boundaries and adjacent requests may be contiguous
framing_steps: find b'\r\n\r\n' to know where headers end
inspect Content-Length; default body length to zero when absent in this MP subset
only cut request when len(buffer) >= message_end
retain buffer[message_end:] for the next request
use an inner loop to consume every complete request already buffered before awaiting more network data
model.partial_body_behavior: if headers are complete but body bytes are incomplete, current connection task awaits more reader data and suspends; event loop can run other connection tasks
parsing_after_framing: split complete request at first header/body delimiter
decode start line and derive method/path
parse remaining header lines into dict[str,str]
